messages.subject: surface plot with original xy
parts:
Hi

Im trying to generate a surface plot with the original xy  points on the surface

thisi is the code for the surface

mw<-ggplot(m,aes(x = x, y = y, z = value, fill = value)) + 
   geom_tile() + 
  coord_equal() +#zlim(40, 44)+
  geom_contour(color = "white", alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_distiller(palette="Spectral", na.value="white",limits = c(0,95)) + 
  theme_bw()+facet_wrap(~variable,ncol=3)
  

this is what I tried to add to the plot

geom_point(data = avpr10, aes(x = x, y = y))

this is the error:
Error in FUN(X[[i]], ...) : object 'value' not found

is it because of the facet_wrap? do I need to have the same amount of data for the facet_wrap?
or I can go around it

messages.author: f14d4c9d01f43388
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: surface plot with original xy
parts:
This is likely because you define the aes(z=value) in the first layers. So further layers are looking for that variable, even if irrelevant for next geometries. So either:
a) define the layer-specific aesthetics at the layer level
b) feed a dummy z value in the new dattaset

You unfortunately did not provide a reproducible example, but see below how to reproduce the error you get. Solution a) here is:    geom_tile(aes(fill=z), colour = "grey50")

df <- data.frame(
  x = rep(c(2, 5, 7, 9, 12), 2),
  y = rep(c(1, 2), each = 5),
  z = factor(rep(1:5, each = 2)),
  w = rep(diff(c(0, 4, 6, 8, 10, 14)), 2)
)

ggplot(df, aes(x, y, fill = z)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(data = select(df, -z), aes(x=x, y=y))
